title: MCP & skills
subtitle: The live capability catalog — MCP servers, tools, skills and how they are wired.

servers.name: Server
servers.emptyHint: Servers appear here as the inventory and introspection planes discover them.

connection.caption: Last observed connection signal — not a formal uptime/SLA.

detail.title: Server detail
detail.healthCaption: Basic connection state from the last signal — not a formal SLA.
detail.consumersHint: Sessions and agents connected to this server.
detail.noConfigHint: This server runs with its discovered settings. Add a managed config to govern its transport and secret references.

tools.name: Tool
tools.untrustedNote: Annotations are self-reported by the MCP server and are NOT verified. They are shown as signals only — the control plane never enforces on them.

toolPins.title: Current pins
toolPins.description: Approved MCP tool fingerprints that form the current authorization baseline.
toolPins.emptyHint: No MCP tool fingerprints are pinned for this tenant.
toolPins.enterprise: Tool pins are an enterprise capability. This build has no enterprise verifier wired yet.
toolPins.driftsHint: These observed fingerprints differ from the approved authorization baseline. Review each change before approving it.
toolPins.approveBody: This replaces the pinned fingerprint with the currently drifted fingerprint and changes the tool authorization baseline.
toolPins.unpinBody: This removes the tool’s pinned authorization baseline. Future use will require a newly approved pin.
toolPins.conflictTitle: “{{tool}}” changed while you were reviewing it
toolPins.conflictBody: The engine refused the change: the pin state moved between your read and your write. Nothing was applied. Compare what you reviewed with what is there now, then decide again.
toolPins.conflictGone: This tool no longer has a pin. Someone else revoked it while you were reviewing.

skills.name: Skill
skills.caption: Claude Code plugins and subagents surface here as connectors discover them. Metadata is intentionally minimal.

wiring.title: Capability wiring
wiring.mobileHint: The wiring graph ({{count}} connections) is best viewed on a larger screen.
wiring.description: What is connected to what — agents and sessions to the MCP servers, tools, skills and resources they use.
wiring.notAccessMap: This is the capability-connection graph, not the R/RW resource access map (see Access map).
wiring.partial: Showing a partial graph — refine the filters to see specific connections.

configs.emptyHint: Create a managed config to govern an MCP server’s transport, scope and secret references.

editor.serverRefHint: The MCP server name this config governs. Immutable after creation.
editor.endpointHint: A reference only — never embed a credential in the endpoint.
editor.secretRefsHint: References to credentials stored outside the console — never the values themselves.
editor.credentialWarning: That looks like a credential value. Enter a reference (e.g. $GITHUB_TOKEN or a vault path), never the secret itself.
editor.confirmCreateBody: Creates a managed config for “{{server}}” and starts an immutable revision history. Recorded in the audit ledger under your identity.
editor.confirmUpdateBody: Bumps the revision and writes an immutable history snapshot for “{{server}}”. Audited under your identity. The server reference cannot be changed.

remove.title: Delete managed config?
remove.body: Appends a final “delete” snapshot to the immutable history for “{{server}}” and is audited under your identity. The MCP server keeps running with its discovered settings.

revisions.title: Revision history
revisions.subtitle: Immutable, newest-first snapshots for “{{server}}”.
revisions.caption: History survives deletion — the last entry is a “delete” snapshot.
revisions.truncatedHint: The history is longer than this page. A revision missing from this list does not prove it was never recorded.

config.title: No managed configs created yet
config.description: Create a managed config to govern an MCP server’s transport, scope, and secret references.

server.title: No MCP servers discovered yet
server.description: MCP servers appear when connector observations identify them in the tenant’s inventory.

skill.title: No skills discovered yet
skill.description: Skills come from MCP prompt introspection; a Claude Code source reports subagents, skills and plugins as declared resources, not into this table.

tool.title: No MCP tools discovered yet
tool.description: Tools appear when MCP introspection or observed tool activity reports them to the tenant’s inventory.

truncatedHint: There are more rows than shown; this page takes them by row id (assigned at creation), so the later ones are missing. A server, tool, skill or config NOT listed here is not proof that it does not exist.
